text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
I guess I somehow managed to finish the run!☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh, that girl has quite an interesting running style.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, her judgment around the corners and stuff was pretty unique, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feng Shui lies at the core of Copano Rickey's running style.
It seemed to leave quite an impression of just how unique she is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I knew changing the door's color
to orange was the right move!
It felt so totally amazing to run☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um, so about our next goal,
what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd like to win a big race as soon as I can
to show everyone they can find happiness, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there's definitely something
I'm sorely lacking right now, isn't there?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What is fundamentally lacking.
If it's related to Feng Shui, then it must be...
choice_data_list: Like good luck or the flow of ki?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean.
What's lacking is 'sheer ability'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, the response I got was
a completely sound and reasonable argument.
On top of that, she kindly explained it in detail.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui... doesn't work miracles.
It's simply a way to arrange your environment
so that you can bring out the absolute best in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Look, someone who's never played soccer before
could never beat a pro, right?
It's the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is merely a discipline
meant to help you "do everything within your power."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The center of the current Twinkle Series is a massive vortex of ki.
It's not impossible for it to work, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Just setting the stage won't cut it.
It might be too early for the big races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems feng shui isn't all-powerful.
I decided to talk about our goals—another day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And some time later, one day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae! Hokko Tarumae holds on to cross the finish line! She wins the GIII race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Her very first graded race victory at last! The Angel of Tomakomai finally brings good news back home!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… I really did it!
Bringing a trophy to Tomakomai for the first time……!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Tarumae!
That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rickey. Today... Today I swore
I'd run a race worthy of our sash, and I finally...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A sash? You mean...
the kind you wear across your shoulder?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Someone from my hometown gave it to me.
Someone who loves Tomakomai and always puts it first...
And as for me..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They gave me a handmade sash saying, 'Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador'.
But I haven't really been able to live up to it until now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And today, finally...!
I feel like I was able to give back, even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it was. What a relief...!
I'm so happy for you, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Hokko Tarumae, a hardworking Umamusume who was always one step ahead,
it seemed spring was finally beginning to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tarumae! Then from now on,
so you can achieve even greater success for your hometown—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Won't you hear out my feng shui advice? I'm sure it'll come in handy."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Feng shui...? Geez, Ricky, you really need to take this seriously, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to be passionate about your hobbies, but
you have to prioritize the people who help you
and cheer you on first.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: See ya. Thanks for celebrating with me today.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tarumae...! Hmm,
people who help and support me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What Tarumae said
makes total sense, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, the people around you are part of your "environment" too.
Yeah, the people around you are part of your "environment" too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well said! Yep, exactly☆
Looks like the Feng Shui mindset is
starting to rub off on you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Then maybe I should try getting more supporters first, just like Tarumae."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. For our next goal, I was thinking
we could gather fans and look for Umamusume
who'd be willing to help out. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, setting up the feng shui environment is top priority.
Instead of pushing for big races, I decided to solidify her foundation."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume to cooperate with, huh.
It's true that to get stronger,
you need a partner like that."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Still~, is there any girl who'd lend us a hand? The dirt track rivals might not want to go along with it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is definitely what you gotta rely on here☆
The lucky color that'll lead me to success is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: O Almanac... tell me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, darkness...? ...No, that's not it.
This is..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—“Black”? The lucky color is “black.”
This color might just be the key
to gathering friends and fans!
